source_truth_statement: observation_notes.content is the complete immutable source; only its derived embedding is absent

live_canonical_input.writer_behavior: observer writer passes complete content to the single embedding call; no safe chunk planner is present on this path

call_chain: observation source content is inserted into public.observation_notes
observer._write_observation_note commits source before derived embedding work
observer._backfill_note_embedding uses the complete observation content as the canonical text
embedding.embed_batch/call_embedding sends that text as one provider request
the parent vector and embed_model are written to public.observation_notes only on success
recall._anchor_expand currently searches the parent observation vector lane; no observation child sidecar lane exists
why_short_is_healthy: short observations fit the configured provider safe target, so the existing full-content single-vector request is valid and preserves current semantics
why_long_fails: long observations are sent unsliced in one request; 8192 provider tokens is a hard ceiling and the 7680 safe target leaves the configured margin, so all six current rows are over both bounds
required_fix: retain complete source; plan tokenizer-safe derived chunks; require all children before aggregate parent; recall child hits back to complete parent
